$comment: Claude Code settings for one unattended run. Copy to the run's own settings directory, replace HOOKS with the path to scripts/hooks.py and SCENARIOS with the absolute path of the evaluation scenarios' directory without its leading slash (a rule path starting with // is absolute; one starting with a single / is relative to the settings file and silently matches nothing). A Read rule also stops cat and the file tools, but not an allowed interpreter such as python3, so it is a guard against accidents, not isolation: keep the scenarios off the implementer's file system for that, and set RUN_STATE_DIR, AGENT_STOP_FILE, EVAL_FEEDBACK, RUN_DEADLINE, STOP_GUARD_CHECKLIST in the environment of the run. Every tool the agent may call is in allow or deny: a tool in neither waits on a permission dialog nobody answers. Adjust the lists to the product; do not replace them with allow-all.
